summary: Decoded RGBA image of a player's custom icon, registered with the UI under a FixedString URI. Written by bg3.exe+0x19789A0 (ecl::IconSystem per-frame update bg3.exe+0x1978500); read by the UI (bg3.exe+0x13D37A0 passes data/width/height/name to the Noesis texture provider).

fields.name: Data
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x197A740 writes 0. Writer bg3.exe+0x19789A0 (ecl::IconSystem per-frame update bg3.exe+0x1978500) frees the old pointer (FUN_14408b980) and stores the result of the image decoder FUN_14408a190(buffer, 4 channels, 0) here; bg3.exe+0x13D37A0 checks it for null and passes it to the texture registration FUN_14138bd60.

fields.name: Width
fields.evidence: Creator writes 0 (8-byte store at +8). The writer stores the decoder's first output dimension here (4-byte store); passed as the 4-byte argument after Data by bg3.exe+0x13D37A0. Width/Height order assumed from the decoder's (x, y) output order.

fields.name: Height
fields.evidence: The writer stores the decoder's second output dimension at +0xC (4-byte store); bg3.exe+0x13D37A0 passes it as the next argument.

fields.name: Uri
fields.evidence: Creator writes 0xFFFFFFFF (null FixedString); the component destructor bg3.exe+0x6A4570 releases a FixedString at +0x10. The writer sets it (IncRef/DecRef) to "Assets/Uri/CustomPlayerIcon/%d"; bg3.exe+0x13D37A0 compares it with the UI's current icon name.
